character.name: Paper Lantern
character.description: A traditional round paper lantern with a warm soft golden glow from within, delicate paper texture with visible bamboo rib frame lines, a small tassel hanging from the bottom, suspended from a loop of string at the top. Render it as a plain, naturalistic decorative object - no face, not anthropomorphized, soft warm inner light glowing through the paper.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
